releases.description:
### Added

- Comments now render inline markdown in editing view — wikilinks, external links, bold, and tags all display formatted, and links are clickable. Requires Obsidian 1.3.5 or later.

### Fixed

- A `|` typed in the Name column no longer swallows the amount and resets it to 0. Pipes inside comments were already safe and stay that way.
- Screen readers now announce links inside a comment as links instead of reading the whole cell as a button.
- Clicking anywhere in a comment cell starts editing again, matching every other column. When a rendered link fills the cell, a pencil appears on hover as the way in.

### Under the hood

- Pinned the Obsidian dependency for reproducible builds and refreshed the README to match actual plugin behavior.

- Long text in Name and Comment cells is now truncated with an ellipsis to keep the table layout tidy.

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
### Changed

- **Breaking:** Plugin ID renamed from `obsidian-budget-planner-plugin` to `budget-planner` to meet Community Plugin submission rules. Existing manual installs need to rename their plugin folder in `.obsidian/plugins/`.
- Editing is noticeably snappier: the editor now applies incremental updates instead of reparsing the whole document on every keystroke.
- The default budget block template now shows a realistic budget example instead of generic sample text.

### Fixed

- Prevented data loss when switching files mid-edit — changes are now synced to the document immediately rather than on teardown.
- Category names ending with `:` no longer get corrupted into `::` on round-trips through the parser.
- Lines missing the `|` separator no longer produce phantom rows in the table.
- Inline triple backticks in row names or comments no longer prematurely close the budget block.
- Undo, drag-and-drop, and column sorting now correctly refresh cell contents instead of showing stale data.
- Pressing Escape while editing no longer triggers an extra save.
- The "Delete category" context menu item now updates correctly after adding a second category.
- Checkbox state no longer visually resets when rows are reordered.
- The cursor can now move below a budget block at the end of a document.
- Inserting a budget block now adds a trailing newline so the cursor lands on a fresh line.
- Trailing whitespace is no longer written out in rows without comments.

### Under the hood

- Upgraded core tooling (Vite 8, TypeScript 6, ESLint 10, Vitest 4) and refreshed dependencies, refactored internal state management and decoration updates, expanded test coverage, and rebuilt the release workflow around a `/release` Claude Code slash command with automated CHANGELOG extraction.

## New

  - **Drag & drop** — reorder rows and categories, move rows between categories (grip
  handle on the left).

  ## Fixes
  - Edited values no longer roll back after blur or other actions.
  - No double-write when the block is re-rendered; pending saves cancelled on destroy.

  ## Stability
  - Immutable store updates, commit from current state, dirty flag for destroy.

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## Bug Fixes

  - Checkbox saves immediately on click — Toggling a checkbox now persists to markdown
  instantly instead of requiring a blur event. Previously, checkbox state could be lost if the
  user navigated away before clicking outside the table.
  - New rows no longer disappear after creation — Fixed the formatter incorrectly dropping rows
   when only one of name/amount was empty. Rows are now only discarded when both name and
  amount are missing, matching documented behavior.
  - Race condition in TableWidget resolved — Fixed a race condition in the widget lifecycle
  that could cause stale data or lost edits during concurrent save operations.
  - UI disabled during save — Added isSaving state to prevent user interactions (checkbox
  clicks, edits, row creation) while a save is in progress, avoiding data corruption.

## Improvements

  - Refactored save pipeline — Replaced the old BudgetCodeBlock/BudgetCodeWriter approach with
  a streamlined TableWidget that manages its own CodeMirror dispatches. The widget now
  dynamically locates its position in the document, eliminating stale offset bugs.
  - Improved table layout — Updated padding and styling for header, footer, category footer,
  and add-row components for better visual consistency.
  - Disabled-state UX — AddRow and Editable components now properly reflect the disabled state
  during saves.

 ## Internal

  - Updated dependencies (ESLint, svelte-check, Vitest, Vite)
  - Enforced branch requirement in release script (releases must run from master)
  - Removed unused BudgetCodeWriter class and UiStateStore
  - Extracted BUDGET_BLOCK_REGEX to shared constants module
